RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel in banking often reflects systemic underrepresentation rather than deliberate discrimination, though unconscious affinity bias is always possible. However, for a "Head of" role, institutions routinely prioritize broad regulatory and governance experience over purely technical quantitative credentials. 

Raising the panel’s gender makeup now will trigger HR and legal defensiveness, eliminating your chances of receiving candid feedback and risking your professional network. Instead, send a polite follow-up focusing on constructive feedback regarding regulatory leadership. Document all communications, and only raise bias if you consult an employment attorney who identifies concrete evidence of discrimination.
